body:
I had recently heard of a relation in chemicals in cannabis and hops so I figured a I could intensify the effect of both by using them together. I brewed a big rich cup of hop tea which my mum gave me from work (she worked in a drug rehabilitation centre and it was recommended as a suitable supplement for heroin withdrawal however not to popular among heroin addicts).
I drank my tea it tasted ok. An effect quickly came on a really heavy feeling. I felt really dizzy and proceeded to smoke a bong, it was a really intense hit. I was left on the bed paralysed in ecstasy. I still felt very dizzy, I had a really dry mouth.
I slept unusually well that night and awoke with no present hangover. It was a really cool experience and I have done it many times since. A cannabis high with a really wobbly feeling to it.
